translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Akt
book.title: Akt Riy ta paliinna ku Iisa Masi

content: Pool ɗo kiɗ ka Maalt
Min okintini amil cewey, ŋu kaawinti a kiɗ-aŋ siŋji Maalt. Ŋa goy ɗatik amiydi.
Gee ku darre-ak obinti samaane. Ɗo wer-ak, us diyaw ho amay sa teestu n̰oke. Paa ko, ŋu ŋaaminti ako ho ni ooriyo.
Pool soktu atay a ŋaa leen̰co ɗo aki. Kar wiktin ta ŋa leeyiigu, aal umiig ɗo pisin̰ji ho ŋa caaltu asaan ak cokiiji toŋgo.

Wiktin taat gee ku Maalt taliig aal kaak kaltuw ɗo pisin̰ji-ak, ŋu kaawtu benannico aman : « Gem-aŋ, ka seener, ŋaar daa gee. Min ɗo amiydi diŋ sa ŋa pake, kar seriin ta Buŋdi gay rasaagɗo, ŋaa maten di ka. »
Ɗo wer-ak, Pool ergiig aal-ak ɗo aki ho ŋa bal aawe yoo maanna.
Okin̰co ŋu era akuun pisin̰ yaa waase ho wal ŋaa galeŋ ko bup di, ŋaa mate. Ŋu ƴokiy paa, yoo maan sa gingigɗo. Hiyya, ŋu ictu kaaw ta pey ho ŋu kaawtu aman : « Way, ŋaar-aŋ oki buŋ rakki ! »
Moota ɗo wer-ak, gin gem rakki kaak ŋu kolaag Publiyuus. Min agindaw ku kiɗ-ak, ŋaar di kaaco. Ŋa obinti ar siŋtay iŋ gelbin rakki. Ni gintu mena subba ɗo geriy.
Sando, takan̰ Publiyuus gay raɗaw. Ziŋkay toŋgo ho ŋa tennaw. Ŋa weƴa ka daŋlil. Min Pool doriit kaaw-at, ŋa un̰jitu, ŋa leeyiiji pisin̰ji ɗo kaay ho ŋa salkiyiiji. Ek di gem-ak cooltu.
Min gee kuuk raɗaw ku pey doriit kabarre-at, ŋu asiig gas Pool ho ŋa cooliigu.
Gee ku darrer-ak berinti horoomin dakina. Wiktin taat ni rakiy n̰epe markaba nii ɗeete, ŋu berinti oki zaadin ta martuwni.
Pool ot ɗo geeger ka Room
Ni goytu ɗo kiɗ ka Maalt koyin subba, kar ni n̰eptu markaba. Markab-ak gay, ŋu kolaag « Diyoskuur » ho ŋa min kiɗ ka Alekzandri. Ŋa goy wiktin ta siteener ɗo kiɗ ka Maalt.
Min ni n̰eptu markab-ak, ni birtu ɗo geeger ka Siraakuuz. Min ni ottu ɗo wer-aka, ni jammiytu mena subba.
Min eɗe, ni jarbitu moota iŋ kiɗ-aka nam ni ottu ɗo geeger ka Riggiyo. Ka kawtinti, us kaak asa min watiine teestu abire. Hiyya, ni amiltu min eɗe. Ni gin mena seer ja kat ni ottu Puuzol.
Ɗo geeger ŋaar-ak, ni gastu gee ku aamin ɗo Iisa indinti a nii goye mena peesira iŋ ŋuura. Min mena kuuk peesir-ak gaastu, hiyya, ni birtu kat Room.
Gee ku aamine ku Room gas kabarrini a ni asa ɗo botildi. Paa ko, ŋu uctu a ŋuuni ŋaame. Ŋu ŋaaminti ɗo werin kuuk ŋu kolaag « Suugin ta Apiyuus » ho « Geray Subba ku Martir ».
Min Pool taliigu, ŋa deliiji barkin ɗo Buŋdi ho ŋa ɗeŋirtu.
Min ni ottu Room, ŋu beriiji izinne a ŋaa goye ger keeji di. Ɗo wer kaak ŋa goyiy gay, gin askirin̰ce gooƴaaga.
Pool gaara kaaw ta Buŋdi Room

Gin mena subba, Pool koliig agindaw ku Yuudinnar ku Room a ŋuu n̰ume ɗo weriy. Min ŋu n̰umtu, ŋa kaawiico aman : « Gem kol siŋtay, nun kaak ku taliy-aŋ, ŋu obintu min Zeruzaleem ho ŋu sakkiyintu ɗo uŋco ka gee ku Room kuuk goy annere. Ŋu obintu maalan di, wala nu nig iŋ geente, wala nu nig aadanna ku aginiyte.
Min gee ku Room taliit kaawor, ŋu rak pikindu asaan ŋu bal gase oorin taat yaa iye muutur.
Kar Yuudinna gay pooce ho kaaw-at gindu raɗa. Ek di nu birtu sakkiye ɗo wer ka sultan ka tatik ka Room. Kar sakkiyindu gay, nu rakaaɗo loomayin ta siŋta ku darrer.
Ɗo bi ŋaar-ak ko, nu koliŋko gii ŋaame ho naako gaare baati. Kuŋ ibingig maan kaak gee ku Israyeel eriyo. Ɗo saan taar-ak ko, ŋu ɗooɗintu iŋ jinzirre. »
Kar agindaw ku Yuudinnar gay telkiiji aman : « Nin anne, ni bal gase yoo maktumne rakki min Zuude taat kaawa bin̰ ho ginno siŋni kaak as min annere kaak nig biy iŋ kiŋke.
Kar nin gay raka cokiyin taat kiŋ meen̰ji pakiriyo, asaan ni iban, ay wero, gee kaawa gallo ɗo botol taat ki aaɗiy-anta. »

Hiyya, ŋu diytu ƴiriy rakki taat ŋuu n̰ume. Min ƴiriy taar-at astu, Yuudinna dakina n̰umtu pey ɗo weriy, pak ka awalle. Min kawtira yoo maako, Pool osiico kaawin dakina. Ŋa gaariico *Meennaw ta Buŋdi. Ho ŋa bariya pey botol taat ŋaaco gedire ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi min ɗo *gaanuun ka Muusa ho min makaatamna ku nabiinnar.
Daarin̰ ooyit kaaw-ata ho daarin̰ gay poocta.
Kaawco bal n̰ume ho ŋu raka ɗeete. Ɗo wer-ak, Pool kaawiico pey aman : « Kaaw taat Ruwwin ta Buŋdi kaawiico ɗo aginiyko min ɗo bi ka nabi Ezaayi, taar ka seener.
Ta kaawa aman :

content.text: ‟ Ɓaa gasig gee-aŋku ho kaawco aman :
Kuu cokiye paa, kar ku ibinaaɗo baati.
Kuu tale paa, kar ku talaaɗo maanna.
Ŋu pooc jipte goyin̰co iŋ nunu,
paa kat, nu baltu gedire coolin̰co. ”

content: Kar Pool kaawiico pey aman : « Diyoŋ ɗo kaƴko, Buŋ iyiit Kabarre ta Gala ta jile geemir ɗo gee kuuk Yuudinnaɗo. Gee ŋuur-ak kat yaa ooyin kaaw-ata. »
[Min Pool gaasiit kaawoy, hiyya, *Yuudinna amiltu min ɗo geriy ho ŋu teestu meele benannico.]
Min ŋaar-ak, Pool goytu pey elgin seer karaat ɗo ger kaak ŋa ajjirtu-aka. Ɗo geriy-ak, ŋa obaag ay gem kaak asa talin̰ji di.
Kar ŋa gaariicot Meennaw ta Buŋdi ho ŋa garkiyiigu ɗo bi ka *Rabbin Iisa Masi bal kolaw. Ginno waan kaak toɗaaji.

footnotes.text: Wer ka n̰umin̰co-ak serek pak kilomeetir orok beeƴ min Room.
Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Ezaayi 6.9-10.
Kaaw taar-an ginno ɗo makaatamna daarin̰ ku Buŋdi kuuk ŋu siirtu min awalle iŋ kaaw ta Grek.
